items.e: It was in the thirtieth year from the time Chilkiyahu the Kohen Gadol found the Sefer Torah in the Beis Hamikdash, in the Azarah under the Ulam, at midnight after the setting of the moon, in the days of Yoshiyahu son of Amon, king of the tribe of the house of Yehudah, in Tammuz, on the fifth of the month, the navi said: I was among the exiles by the river Kevar, the heavens opened and I saw in a vision of nevuah that rested upon me the vision of the glory of the Shechinah of Hashem.
On the fifth of the month, which was the fifth year of the exile of King Yoyachin.

The word of nevuah from before Hashem had been with Yechezkel son of Buzi the kohen in the land of Yisrael; it returned a second time and spoke with him in the province of the land of the Kasdim by the river Kevar, and the spirit of nevuah from before Hashem rested upon him there.

I saw, and behold, a storm wind came from the north, a great cloud and a flashing fire, and a brightness surrounded it, and from the midst of the cloud and from the midst of the storm wind, like the color of the chashmal (glowing metal) out of the midst of the fire.
From its midst was the likeness of four chayos (living creatures), and this was their appearance: they had the likeness of a human.

There were four faces to one, and four faces to each and every one, making sixteen faces to one chayah; the number of the faces of the four chayos was sixty-four faces. And there were four wings to one, and four wings to each and every one, sixteen to each face, making sixty-four wings to one chayah; and the number of the wings of the four chayos was two hundred and fifty-six wings.
Their legs were straight legs, and the soles of their feet were like the sole of a round foot, making the world tremble when they walk, and they sparkled like the color of burnished copper.

Hands like human hands were made for them under their wings on their four sides, to take with them coals of fire from between the keruvim beneath the firmament that was over their heads, to place upon the hands of the seraphim to throw upon the place of the wicked to destroy the sinners who transgress His word; and the faces and wings of the four of them were equal.
Their wings were directed one toward the other; they did not turn when they walked; each chayah went straight in the direction of its face.

The likeness of their faces was the face of a human, and the face of a lion was made on the right side for the four of them, and the face of an ox was made on the left side for the four of them, and the face of an eagle for the four of them.
Their faces and their wings were separated from above; two of each were directed one to the other, and two covered their bodies.
Each chayah went straight in the direction of its face; to the place where there was the Will to go, they went; they did not turn when they walked.

The likeness of the chayos, their appearance was like burning coals of fire, like the appearance of torches; a flashing fire was between the chayos, and the fire had a brightness, and out of the fire went forth lightning.

The chayos, when they were sent to do the will of their Master, whose Shechinah rests in the highest heights above them, their appearance to the eye was turning and encircling and covering the world, and the chayos returned at once, and they were swift as the appearance of lightning.
I saw the chayos, and behold, one ofan (wheel) rested below the heights of heaven, beside the chayos, for its four faces.
The appearance of the wheels and their work was like the color of a precious stone, and the four of them had one likeness; and their appearance and their work was as if a wheel were within a wheel.
They went on their four sides when they walked; they did not turn when they walked.
Their backs were directed opposite the firmament, and they had height, and they were awesome, and their backs were full of eyes all around the four of them.
When the chayos walked, the wheels went beside them; and when the chayos were lifted up from below the heights of heaven, the wheels were lifted up.
To the place where there was the Will to go, they went; there was the Will to go; and the wheels were lifted up opposite them, for the spirit of the chayos was in the wheels.

When those walked, these walked; and when those stood still, these stood still; and when those were lifted up from below the heights of heaven, the wheels were lifted up opposite them, for the spirit of the chayos was in the wheels.
The likeness over the heads of the chayos was a firmament, like the color of awesome ice, stretched out over their heads from above.
Under the firmament, their wings were directed one toward the other; each had two covering them, and each had two covering their bodies.

I heard the sound of their wings, like the sound of many waters, like the voice from before Shaddai when they walked, the sound of their speaking when they gave thanks and blessed their Master, the living King of the worlds, like the sound of the camps of the angels on high; when they stood still, their wings were silent from speaking.

At the time there was a Will before Him to make the word heard to His servants the neviim of Yisrael, there was a voice, and it was heard from above the firmament, from between the keruvim under the firmament that was over their heads; when they stood still, their wings were silent from speaking.

Above the firmament that was over their heads was like the appearance of a sapphire stone, the likeness of a throne; and upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness as the appearance of a man upon it from above.

I saw like the color of the chashmal, like the appearance of fire within it all around; an appearance of glory that the eye cannot behold, and it is impossible to look at it; and upwards, an appearance of glory that the eye cannot behold, and it is impossible to look at it; and downwards I saw like the appearance of fire, and it had brightness all around.

Like the appearance of the rainbow that is in the cloud on a day of rain, so was the appearance of the brightness all around; that was the appearance of the likeness of the glory of Hashem. And I saw, and I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice speaking.
And He said to me, "Ben adam, stand on your feet and I will speak with you."
And a spirit entered into me as He spoke with me, and it stood me upon my feet, and I heard the One speaking with me.

And He said to me, "Ben adam, I am sending you to the Bnei Yisrael, to the rebellious nations who have rebelled against My word; they and their fathers have rebelled against My word until this very day.
And as they are called children, they are brazen-faced and hard-hearted. I am sending you to them, and you shall say to them, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim.'
And they, whether they accept instruction or whether they refrain from sinning—for they are a rebellious people—they shall know that a navi has been among them.

And you, ben adam, do not be afraid of them, and do not be afraid of their words, for they are rebellious and stubbornly oppose you, and you dwell among a people whose deeds are like scorpions. Do not be afraid of their words, and do not be broken before them, for they are a rebellious people.
And you shall prophesy the words of My nevuah to them, whether they accept instruction or whether they refrain from sinning, for they are a rebellious people.
And you, ben adam, accept what I speak with you; do not be rebellious like the rebellious people. Humble your soul and accept what I give you."
And I saw, and behold, the likeness of a hand was stretched out toward me, and behold, in it was a scroll of a book.

And He spread it before me, and behold, it was written on its front and on its back what was from the beginning and what is destined to be at the end. And it was written in it that if the house of Yisrael transgress the Torah, the nations will rule over them; but if they fulfill the Torah, lamentation, mourning, and sighing will pass away from them.
And He said to me, "Ben adam, what is given to you, accept; accept what is written in this scroll, and go and prophesy to the house of Yisrael."
And I humbled my soul, and He made me wise in what is written in this scroll.

And He said to me, "Ben adam, your soul shall be satisfied and your stomach shall be filled if you accept what is written in this scroll that I give you." And I accepted it, and its words were in my mouth sweet as honey.
And He said to me, "Ben adam, come, go to the Bnei Yisrael, and prophesy My words of nevuah to them.
For you are not sent to a people of deep speech and difficult language, but rather to the house of Yisrael.
Not to many nations of strong speech and difficult language, whose words you will not understand; had I sent you to them, they would have accepted it from you.
But the house of Yisrael will not be willing to accept it from you, for they do not desire to accept My word; for the whole house of Yisrael are brazen-faced and hard-hearted.
Behold, I have made your face strong against their faces, and your eyes fierce against their eyes.
Like a shamir that is stronger than rock, so have I made your eyes fierce against their faces; do not be afraid of them, and do not be broken before them, for they are a rebellious people."
And He said to me, "Ben adam, all My words that I will speak with you, accept in your heart and hear with your ears.
And come, go to the exiles, to the children of your people, and prophesy to them, and say to them, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim,' whether they accept instruction or whether they refrain from sinning."
And a spirit lifted me up, and I heard behind me a great sound of movement, praising and saying, "Blessed is the glory of Hashem from the place of His Shechinah."
And the sound of the wings of the chayos touching one another, and the sound of the wheels opposite them, and a great sound of movement.
And the spirit lifted me up and took me away, and I went in bitterness, in the strength of my spirit; and the nevuah from before Hashem was strong upon me.
And I came to the exiles at Tel Aviv, who were dwelling by the river Kevar, and I rested among them where they were dwelling there, and I sat there for seven days, silent among them.
And it was at the end of seven days, that the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, I have appointed you as a teacher for the house of Yisrael; and you shall accept the word from My mouth, and you shall warn them against sinning before Me.

When I say to the wicked, 'You shall surely die,' and you do not warn him, and you do not speak to warn the wicked from his wicked way to keep him alive; that wicked one shall die in his sin, but his blood I will demand from your hand.
But you, if you have warned the wicked, and he does not turn from his sin and from his wicked way; he shall die in his sin, but you have saved your soul.

And when a righteous person turns from his righteousness and acts falsely, and I place a stumbling block of sins before him, he shall die; because you did not warn him, he shall die in his sin, and his righteous deeds that he did will not be remembered, but his blood I will demand from your hand.
But you, if you have warned the righteous person so that the righteous will not sin, and he does not sin; he shall surely live, because he took warning, and you have saved your soul."
And the spirit of nevuah from before Hashem rested upon me there, and He said to me, "Arise, go out to the valley, and there I will speak with you."
And I arose and went out to the valley, and behold, the glory of Hashem was resting there, like the glory that I saw by the river Kevar; and I fell upon my face.
And a spirit entered into me, and stood me upon my feet, and spoke with me, and said to me, "Go in, hide yourself within your house.
And you, ben adam, behold, the decrees of My mouth are upon you like ropes with which they bind, and you shall not go out among them.
And I will make your tongue cleave to your palate, and you shall be silent, and you shall not be to them a man of reproof, for they are a rebellious people.

But when I speak with you, you shall humble your soul, and you shall say to them, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim'; he who accepts, let him accept instruction, and he who refrains, let him refrain from sinning; for they are a rebellious people."
And you, ben adam, take for yourself a brick and place it before you, and portray upon it a city, Yerushalayim.
And you shall place a siege against it, and build a siege tower against it, and set up camps against it, and set up battering rams around it.

And you, take for yourself an iron pan and place it as an iron wall between you and the city; and direct your face toward it, and it shall be under siege, and you shall besiege it; this is a sign for the house of Yisrael.

And you, lie on your left side and place the punishment for the sins of the house of Yisrael upon it; according to the number of the days that you lie upon it, you shall bear the punishment for their sins.
And I have given you regarding their sins, for the number of the days, three hundred and ninety days, and you shall bear the punishment for the sins of the house of Yisrael.

And you shall complete these, and you shall lie on your right side a second time, and you shall bear the punishment for the sins of the house of Yehudah forty days; a day for a year, a day for a year, I have given them to you.
And toward the siege of Yerushalayim you shall direct your face, and your arm shall be bared, and you shall prophesy against it.
And behold, I have decreed concerning you like ropes of binding, and you shall not turn from side to side until you complete the days of your siege.

And you, take for yourself wheat, and barley, and beans, and lentils, and millet, and spelt, and you shall place them for yourself to eat; according to the number of the days that you lie upon your side, three hundred and ninety days you shall eat of it.
And your food that you shall eat shall be by weight, twenty pyles a day; from time to time you shall eat it.
And water you shall drink by measure, a sixth of a hin; from time to time you shall drink.
And as a cake of barley bread you shall eat it, and you shall bake it over human excrement before their eyes.
And Hashem said, "So shall the Bnei Yisrael eat their food defiled among the nations to where I will exile them."
And I said, "Accept my request, Hashem Elokim; behold, my soul is not defiled, and a carcass or torn animal I have not eaten from my youth until now, and detestable meat has not entered my mouth."
And He said to me, "See, I have given you cow dung instead of human excrement, and you shall prepare your food upon it."
And He said to me, "Ben adam, behold, I am breaking the staff of bread in Yerushalayim, and they shall eat bread by weight and with anxiety, and water by measure and with desolation they shall drink.
So that they may lack food and drink, and a man and his brother will be desolate, and they will rot away in their sins."

And you, ben adam, take for yourself a sharp sword; as a barber's razor you shall take it for yourself, and pass it over your head and over your beard; and you shall take for yourself weighing scales and divide them.

A third you shall burn in the fire in the midst of the city when the days of the siege are fulfilled; and you shall take a third and strike with the sword all around it; and a third shall be scattered, and those who kill with the sword I will unsheathe after them.
And you shall take from there a small number and bind them in your garment edges.
And from them you shall take more and cast them into the midst of the fire, and burn them in the fire; from it a fire will go out against the whole house of Yisrael.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: This is Yerushalayim; I have set her in the midst of the nations, and countries are all around her.

But she changed My judgments to wickedness more than the nations, and My statutes more than the countries that are all around her; for they despised My judgments, and My statutes, they did not walk in them.

Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Because you have sinned more than the nations that are all around you, you have not walked in My statutes, and you have not done My judgments, and even according to the customs of the nations that are all around you, you have not done.
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am sending My anger against you, even I, and I will execute judgments of punishment in your midst in the eyes of the nations.
And I will do in you that which I have not done, and the like of which I will not do again, because of all your abominations.

Therefore, fathers will eat the flesh of their children in your midst, and children will eat the flesh of their fathers; and I will execute judgments of punishment in you, and I will scatter all the remnant of your people to every wind.

Therefore, as I live, says Hashem Elokim, surely, because you have defiled My Mikdash with all your detestable things and with all your abominations, therefore I will cut off the strength of your arm, and My word will not pity, and I too will not have mercy.

A third of you will die by the plague, and will be consumed by famine in your midst; and a third will be killed by the sword all around you; and a third I will scatter to every wind, and those who kill with the sword I will unsheathe after them.

And My anger will be fulfilled, and I will set My wrath upon them, and I will make an end; and they will know that I, Hashem, have decreed with My word and I will fulfill it, when My anger is fulfilled upon them.
And I will make you a ruin and a disgrace among the nations that are all around you, in the eyes of all who pass by.

And you shall be a disgrace and a taunt, a desolation and an astonishment to the nations that are all around you, when I execute judgments of punishment in you in anger, and in wrath, and in fierce anger; I, Hashem, have decreed by My word.

When I incite the arrows of famine, terrible plagues that are prepared for destruction, which I will send to destroy you; and I will increase the famine upon you, and I will break for you the staff of bread.

And I will send upon you famine and wild beasts, and they will bereave you; and plague and slaughter will pass through you, and those who kill with the sword I will bring upon you; I, Hashem, have decreed by My word.
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, accept nevuah concerning the mountains of Yisrael and prophesy over them.

And you shall say, 'Mountains of Yisrael, accept the word of Hashem Elokim. Thus said Hashem Elokim to the mountains and to the hills, to the streams and to the valleys: Behold, I am bringing upon you those who kill with the sword, and I will destroy your bamos.
And your altars will become desolate, and your sun-images will be broken; and I will cast down your slain before the lifeless blocks of your idols.
And I will place the corpses of the Bnei Yisrael before the lifeless blocks of their idols, and I will scatter your bones all around your altars.

In all your dwelling places, the cities will be ruined and the bamos will become desolate, so that your altars will be ruined and become desolate, and your idols will be broken and cease to exist, and your sun-images will be cut down, and your works will be wiped out.
And the slain will be cast down in your midst, and you will know that I am Hashem.
But I will leave a remnant, in that there will be for you those saved from the sword among the nations, when you are scattered in the countries.

And those of you who are saved will remember My fear among the nations where they were taken captive, how I broke their foolish heart which turned away from My service, and the sight of their eyes which strayed after their idols; and they will groan and look upon the evil that they committed in all their abominations.
And they will know that I am Hashem; not for nothing did I decree by My word to do this evil to them.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: Clap your hand and stamp your foot, and say, "Woe over all the evil abominations of the house of Yisrael, who will be cast down by the sword, by famine, and by plague."

He who is far off will die by the plague, and he who is near will be killed by the sword, and he who remains and enters the besieged cities will die by famine; and My anger will be fulfilled upon them.

And you will know that I am Hashem, when their slain will be among the lifeless blocks of their idols, all around their altars, on every high hill, on all the tops of the mountains, under every leafy tree, and under every thick oak, the place where they brought offerings there for the service of all their idols.

And I will raise the stroke of My might against them, and I will make the land a desolation and an astonishment, from the wilderness of Divlah in all their dwelling places; and they will know that I am Hashem.' "
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"And you, ben adam, thus said Hashem Elokim concerning the land of Yisrael: The end has come; the time of punishment has come upon the four corners of the land.
Now the end of the time of punishment has come upon you, and I will send My anger against you, and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will place upon you all your abominations.

And My word will not pity you, and I will not have mercy; for I will place the guilt of your ways upon you, and the punishment for your abominations will be in your midst; and you will know that I am Hashem.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: Evil after evil, behold, it comes!
The end has come; the time of punishment has come, it has awakened against you; behold, it comes!
The kingdom has been revealed against you, O inhabitant of the land; the time of destruction has come, the day of tumult is near, and there is no escape to the strongholds of the mountains.
Now, very soon I will pour out My wrath upon you, and I will fulfill My anger in you, and I will judge you according to your ways, and I will place upon you all your abominations.

And My word will not pity, and I will not have mercy; according to the guilt of your ways I will place upon you, and the punishment for your abominations will be in your midst; and you will know that I, Hashem, bring the blow upon you.
Behold, the day of punishment has come, behold, it comes; the kingdom has been revealed, the rule has sprung up, the wicked one has appeared.
Robbers have risen up to oversee the wicked; there is nothing of them, nor of their tumult, nor of their children, nor of their children's children.
The time of the payment of sins has come, the day of punishment for sins is near; let the buyer not rejoice, and let the seller not mourn, for anger from before Me is upon all their multitude.

For the seller will not return to what was sold, and while they are alive they will be broken in their bodies; for the neviim prophesy concerning all their multitude to return in teshuvah, and they do not return; a man is broken by the sins of his soul, and as long as they endure in teshuvah they do not strengthen themselves.
They blow the blasts of the shofar, they prepare themselves with weapons of war, but no one goes to battle, for anger from before Me is upon all their multitude.
The sword is outside, and plague and famine are inside; whoever is in the field will be killed by the sword, and whoever is in the city, famine and plague will consume him.
And the survivors who escape from them will be on the mountains like doves of the valleys, all of them groaning, every man in the sin of his soul.
All hands will become feeble, and all knees will pour like water.
And they will gird on sackcloth, and submissiveness will cover them, and upon all faces there will be shame, and upon all their heads baldness.

They will cast their silver into the streets, and their gold will become repulsive; their silver and their gold will not be able to save them in the day of Hashem's anger; they will not satisfy their souls, and they will not fill their stomachs, for it was the stumbling block of their sins.
And the beauty of His ornament, He set it for glory; but they made the images of their abominations, their detestable things, with it; therefore I have made it repulsive to them.
And I will deliver it into the hands of the wicked for plunder, and to the guilty of the earth as spoil, and they will profane it.
And I will remove My Shechinah from them, because they have profaned the land, the place of My Shechinah; and the wicked will enter it and profane it.
Make chains, for the land is full of guilty murderers, and the city is full of robbers.
And I will bring the worst of the nations, and they will possess their houses; and I will cause the pride of the wicked to cease, and their sanctuaries will be profaned.
Desolation has reached and come; and they will seek peace, but there will be none.
Brokenness upon brokenness will come, and bad tiding upon bad tiding there will be; and they will seek instruction from a scribe, and Torah will cease from the kohen, and counsel from the wise.

The king will mourn, and the prince will clothe himself in desolation, and the hands of the people of the land will be terrified; I will do with them according to their ways, and according to their customs I will judge them; and they will know that I am Hashem."

And it was in the sixth year, in the sixth month, on the fifth of the month, the navi said: I was sitting in my house, and the zekeinim of the house of Yehudah were sitting before me, and the spirit of nevuah from before Hashem Elokim rested upon me there.

And I saw, and behold, a likeness as the appearance of fire; an appearance of glory that the eye cannot behold and it is impossible to look at it, and downwards an appearance of fire, and an appearance of glory that the eye cannot behold and it is impossible to look at it, and upwards as the appearance of brightness, like the color of the chashmal.

And He stretched out the form of a hand and took me by the hair of my head; and a spirit lifted me up between the earth and the heavens, and brought me to Yerushalayim in a vision of nevuah that rested upon me from before Hashem, to the entrance of the inner gate that opens to the north, where the seat of the image of jealousy that provokes anger was located.
And behold, the glory of the God of Yisrael was there, like the vision that I saw in the valley.

And He said to me, "Ben adam, raise your eyes now toward the direction of the north." And I raised my eyes toward the direction of the north, and behold, north of the gate of the mizbe'ach, this image of jealousy was at the entrance.

And He said to me, "Ben adam, do you see what they are doing, the great abominations that the house of Yisrael are doing here to distance themselves from My Mikdash? But you will turn again and see greater abominations."
And He brought me to the entrance of the courtyard, and I looked, and behold, there was a hole in the wall.
And He said to me, "Ben adam, dig now into the wall." And I dug into the wall, and behold, there was an entrance.
And He said to me, "Go in, and see the evil abominations that they are doing here."
And I went in and looked, and behold, every form of creeping thing and detestable animal, and all the idols that the house of Yisrael worshipped, were portrayed upon the wall all around.

And seventy men of the zekeinim of the house of Yisrael, with Yaazanyahu ben Shafan standing among them, were standing before them, and every man had his censer of incense in his hand, and a thick cloud of incense was rising.

And He said to me, "Have you seen, ben adam, what the zekeinim of the house of Yisrael do in the dark, every man in the chambers of his imagery? For they say, 'Our deeds are not revealed before Hashem; Hashem has abandoned the land.'"
And He said to me, "You will turn again and see greater abominations that they are doing."
And He brought me to the entrance of the gate of the Mikdash of Hashem that opens to the north, and behold, women were sitting there weeping for the Tammuz.
And He said to me, "Have you seen, ben adam? You will turn again and see greater abominations than these."

And He brought me into the inner courtyard of the Mikdash of Hashem, and behold, at the entrance of the Heichal of Hashem, between the Ulam and the mizbe'ach, there were about twenty-five men, with their backs to the Heichal of Hashem and their faces to the east, and they were corrupting themselves and bowing to the east, to the sun.

And He said to me, "Have you seen, ben adam? Is it a light thing to the house of Yehudah to commit the abominations that they have committed here? For they have filled the land with robbery, and have returned to provoke anger before Me, and behold, they are bringing shame to their faces."
"And I too will act in anger; My word will not pity, and I will not have mercy; and they will pray before Me with a loud voice, but I will not accept their tefillah."
And He cried in my ears with a loud voice, saying, "Draw near, those appointed over the city, and each man with his weapon of destruction in his hand."

And behold, six men came from the way of the upper gate that faces north, and each man with his weapon of destruction in his hand; and one man among them was clothed in garments, with a scribe's writing case at his waist. And they went in and stood beside the copper mizbe'ach.

And the glory of the God of Yisrael went up from the keruv upon which it had been resting in the Kodesh Kodashim, and rested above, facing the threshold of the House. And He called to the man clothed in garments, with the scribe's writing case at his waist.

And Hashem said to him, "Pass through the midst of the city, through the midst of Yerushalayim, and mark a mark upon the foreheads of the men who are sighing and groaning over all the abominations that are done in her midst."
And to these He said, and I heard, "Pass through the city after him and kill; let your eye not pity, and do not have mercy.

Old man, young man, and maiden, children and women, you shall kill to destruction; but to any man upon whom is the mark, do not draw near. And begin from My Mikdash." And they began with the zekeinim who were before the House.
And He said to them, "Defile the House, and fill the courtyards with the slain; go out." And they went out and killed in the city.

And it was, as they were killing, and I remained, I fell upon my face and cried out, and said, "Accept my request, Hashem Elokim, will You destroy all the remnant of Yisrael as You pour out Your wrath upon Yerushalayim?"

And He said to me, "The sins of the house of Yisrael and Yehudah are exceedingly great in her, the land is filled with those guilty of death, and the city is filled with the perversion of justice; for they say, 'Hashem has abandoned the inhabitants of the land, and nothing is revealed before Hashem.'
And I too, My word will not pity, and I will not have mercy; the punishment of their ways I have placed upon their heads."
And behold, the man clothed in garments with the scribe's writing case at his waist brought back word, saying, "I have done just as You commanded me."
And I saw, and behold, in the firmament that was over the head of the keruvim, like a precious stone, like the appearance of the likeness of a throne appeared over them.

And He said to the man clothed in garments, and He said, "Go in between the wheels, under the keruv, and fill your hands with coals of fire from between the keruvim, and throw them over the city." And he went in as I was watching.
And the keruvim were standing on the south side of the House when the man went in; and the cloud of glory filled the inner courtyard.

And the glory of Hashem went up from the keruv that it had been resting upon, and rested above, facing the threshold of the House; and the House was filled with the cloud of glory, and the courtyard was filled with the brightness of the glory of Hashem.
And the sound of the wings of the keruvim was heard up to the outer courtyard, like the voice from before Shaddai when He speaks.
And it was, when He commanded the man clothed in garments, saying, "Take fire from between the wheels, from between the keruvim," that he went in and stood beside the wheel.

And the keruv stretched out his hand from between the keruvim to the fire that was between the keruvim, and took of it, and gave it into the hands of the one clothed in garments; and he took it and went out.
And there appeared in the keruvim the form of a human hand under their wings.
And I saw, and behold, four wheels beside the keruvim, one wheel beside one keruv, and one wheel beside another keruv; and the appearance of the wheels was like the color of a precious stone.
And their appearance, the four of them had one likeness, as if a wheel were within a wheel.
When they walked, they went on their four sides; they did not turn when they walked, for to the place where the first one turned, they went after it; they did not turn when they walked.
And all their flesh, and their backs, and their hands, and their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around, for the four of their wheels.
To the wheels, they were called "the wheel" in my hearing.

And there were four faces to each one: the face of the first was the face of a keruv, and the second face was the face of a human, and the third was the face of a lion, and the fourth was the face of an eagle.
And the keruvim were lifted up; they are the chayos that I saw by the river Kevar.
And when the keruvim walked, the wheels went beside them; and when the keruvim lifted their wings to rise up from below the heights of heaven, the wheels also did not turn from beside them.
When they stood still, they stood still; and when they were lifted up, they were lifted up with them, for the spirit of the chayos was in them.
And the glory of Hashem that had been resting facing the threshold of the House departed, and rested upon the keruvim.

And the keruvim lifted their wings and were lifted up from below the heights of heaven before my eyes when they went out, and the wheels were opposite them; and they stood at the entrance of the eastern gate of the House of Hashem, and the glory of the God of Yisrael was over them from above.
They are the chayos that I saw under the glory of the God of Yisrael by the river Kevar; and I knew that they were keruvim.
Each one had four faces, and each one had four wings; and the likeness of a human hand was under their wings.
And the likeness of their faces, they were the faces that I saw by the river Kevar, their appearances and themselves; each chayah went straight in the direction of its face.

And a spirit lifted me up and brought me to the eastern gate of the Mikdash of Hashem that faces east; and behold, at the entrance of the gate were twenty-five men, and I saw among them Yaazanyah the son of Azur and Pelatyah the son of Benayah, the princes of the people.
And He said to me, "Ben adam, these are the men who devise evil and who give wicked counsel in this city;
Who say, 'It is not near to build houses; it is the pot, and we are considered within it like meat cooked in a pot.'
Therefore prophesy against them, prophesy, ben adam."

And the spirit of nevuah from before Hashem rested upon me, and He said to me, "Say, 'Thus said Hashem: So have you said, house of Yisrael, and that which you think and that which comes up on your heart is revealed before Me.
You have multiplied your slain in this city, and you have filled its streets with the slain.
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Your slain whom you have placed in its midst, they are like the meat, and it is like the pot; but you I will exile from its midst.
You have feared those who kill with the sword; and those who kill with the sword I will bring upon you, says Hashem Elokim.
And I will exile you from its midst, and I will deliver you into the hands of strangers, and I will execute judgments of punishment upon you.
By the sword you shall be killed; on the border of the land of Yisrael I will judge you, and you shall know that I am Hashem.
It shall not be to you as a pot, but you shall be in its midst like meat cooked in a pot; on the border of the land of Yisrael I will judge you.
And you shall know that I am Hashem; for you have not walked in My statutes, and you have not done My judgments, but you have done according to the customs of the nations that are all around you.'"

And it was, as I was prophesying, that Pelatyah the son of Benayah died; and I fell upon my face and cried out with a loud voice, and I said, "Accept my request, Hashem Elokim; will You make a complete end with the remnant of Yisrael?"
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, your brothers, your brothers, the men of your kindred, and the entire house of Yisrael, all of them, to whom the inhabitants of Yerushalayim have said, 'Distance yourselves from the fear of Hashem; to us this land is given as an inheritance.'

Therefore say, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: Although I have distanced them among the nations, and although I have scattered them in the countries, I have given them synagogues second to My Mikdash, and they are as a little sanctuary in the countries where they have been exiled.'

Therefore say, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: I will bring you near from among the nations, and I will gather you from the countries where you have been scattered, and I will give you the land of Yisrael.'
And they shall come there, and they shall remove all its detestable things and all its abominations from it.

And I will give them a reverent heart, and a reverent spirit I will put within them; and I will break the heart of the wicked that is hard like stone from their flesh, and I will give them a heart that fears before Me to do My will.
So that they will walk in My statutes, and guard My judgments, and do them; and they shall be a people before Me, and I will be their God.
But those whose heart wanders after the worship of their detestable things and their abominations, the punishment of their ways I have placed upon their heads, says Hashem Elokim."
And the keruvim lifted their wings, and the wheels were opposite them; and the glory of the God of Yisrael was over them from above.
And the glory of Hashem went up from the midst of the city, and rested upon the Mount of Olives that is to the east of the city.

And a spirit lifted me up and brought me to the province of the land of the Kasdim, to the exiles, in the vision by the spirit of nevuah that rested upon me from before Hashem; and the vision that I had seen departed from me.
And I prophesied to the exiles all the words of Hashem that He had shown me.
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, you dwell in the midst of a rebellious people, who have eyes to see but do not see, and ears to hear but do not hear; for they are a rebellious people.

And you, ben adam, prepare for yourself vessels of exile, and go into exile by day before their eyes; and you shall go into exile from your place to another place before their eyes; perhaps they will fear, for they are a rebellious people.
And you shall bring out your vessels like vessels of exile by day before their eyes; and you shall go out in the evening before their eyes, like those who go out into exile.
Before their eyes, dig through the wall and go out through it.
Before their eyes, carry it upon your shoulder, go out in the dark; cover your face so that you will not see the land; for I have set you as a sign to the house of Yisrael."

And I did so, just as I was commanded; I brought out my vessels like vessels of exile by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall with my hand; I went out in the dark, I carried it on my shoulder before their eyes.
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me in the morning, saying:
"Ben adam, did not the house of Yisrael, the rebellious people, say to you, 'What are you doing?'
Say to them, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: This burden of nevuah is upon the prince in Yerushalayim, and all the house of Yisrael who are among them.'
Say, 'I am your sign; just as I have done, so it shall be done to them; into exile, into captivity they shall go.'

And the prince who is among them will carry upon his shoulder in the dark, and will go out; they will dig through the wall to bring him out through it; he will cover his face because he has sinned, so that he will not see the land.
And I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My snare; and I will exile him to Bavel, to the province of the land of the Kasdim; but he will not see it, and there he will die.
And all who are around him, his helpers and all his camps, I will scatter to every wind, and those who kill with the sword I will unsheathe after them.
And they will know that I am Hashem, when I exile them among the nations and scatter them in the countries.

But I will leave a few men of them from the sword, from the famine, and from the plague, so that they may recount all their abominations among the nations where they will be exiled; and they will know that I am Hashem."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, you shall eat your food with trembling, and you shall drink your drink with desolation and astonishment.

And you shall say to the people of the land: Thus said Hashem Elokim to the inhabitants of Yerushalayim upon the land of Yisrael: They shall eat their food with trembling, and they shall drink their drink with astonishment, so that the land may be desolate of its fullness, because of the robbery of all who dwell in it.
And the inhabited cities will be ruined, and the land will become a desolation; and you will know that I am Hashem."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, what is this proverb of yours upon the land of Yisrael, saying, 'The days are prolonged, and every nevuah will be nullified'?

Therefore say to them, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: I will nullify this proverb, and they will no longer use it as a proverb in Yisrael. Rather, prophesy to them: The days draw near, and the word of every nevuah.'
For there will no longer be any false nevuah or deceitful divination among the Bnei Yisrael.

For I am Hashem; I will speak the word that I will speak, and it will be fulfilled and will no longer be delayed; for in your days, O rebellious people, I will speak a word and fulfill it, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, behold, the house of Yisrael say, 'The teaching that he teaches is for many days to come, and he prophesies for distant times.'
Therefore say to them, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: None of My words will be delayed anymore; the word that I speak will be fulfilled, says Hashem Elokim.'"
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, prophesy against the false prophets who prophesy, and say to those who prophesy from the will of their own hearts: Accept the word of Hashem.
Thus said Hashem Elokim: Woe to the false prophets who act foolishly, who go after the thoughts of their own hearts, and have seen nothing.
Like foxes in the ruins have your false prophets been, O Yisrael.

You did not stand in the breach, and you did not perform good deeds for yourselves to seek mercy for the house of Yisrael, to stand to seek mercy for them at the time when those who make war came upon them in the day of the anger of Hashem.
They prophesy falsehood and teach lies, saying, 'Hashem said,' but Hashem did not send them, and they brazenly expect their word to be fulfilled.
Did you not prophesy a false prophecy and speak a lying divination, and you say, 'Hashem said,' but from before Hashem it was not spoken?
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Because you have prophesied falsehood and taught lies, therefore behold, I am sending My anger against you, says Hashem Elokim.

And the blow of My might will be against the false prophets who prophesy falsehood and teach lies; in the good secret that is hidden for My people they will not be, and in the book of eternal life that is written for the righteous of the house of Yisrael they will not be inscribed, and into the land of Yisrael they will not enter; and you will know that I am Hashem Elokim.

Because they prophesied falsehood, and because they misled My people, saying, 'Peace,' but there is no peace; and they are like one who builds a partition wall and smears it with untempered clay that has no straw.

Say to the one who builds a partition wall and smears it with untempered clay that has no straw: It will fall! Now there will be an overwhelming rain, and hailstones will come down, and storm winds will split it.
And behold, the wall has fallen! Will it not be said to you, 'Where is the smearing that you smeared?'

Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: I will bring a king who is strong as storm winds in My wrath, and killing nations like overwhelming rain in My anger will come, and mighty kingdoms like hailstones in rage, to destroy.

And I will break down the city in which you prophesied false prophecy, and I will cast it to the ground, and its foundations will be revealed, and it will fall, and you will be consumed in its midst; and you will know that I am Hashem.
And My anger will be fulfilled in the city, and against the false prophets who prophesied false prophecy in it, and it will be said to you, 'There is no city, and there are no false prophets';
The false prophets of Yisrael who prophesy concerning Yerushalayim, and mislead her with teachings of peace, but there is no peace, says Hashem Elokim.
And you, ben adam, accept nevuah concerning the daughters of your people, who prophesy according to the will of their own hearts, and prophesy against them.

And you shall say, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: Woe to them who sew dark bands on all the elbows of the hands, and make veils on the head of every stature to destroy souls! Are you able to destroy the souls of My people? And as to keeping alive, are you even able to keep your own souls alive?

And you have profaned My will among My people for handfuls of barley and pieces of bread, to put to death souls that should not die—but you are not able to put them to death; and to keep alive souls that should not live to be kept alive—but you are not able to keep them alive; by your lies to My people who listen to lies.

Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Behold, I am sending My anger upon the dark bands with which you mislead, saying about them, "We perform sorcery with them upon souls to destroy"; and I will tear them from your arms, and I will save the souls against whom you perform your sorcery to destroy them.
And I will tear your veils, and I will save My people from your hands, and they will no longer be delivered into your hands for destruction; and you will know that I am Hashem.

Because you have made the heart of the righteous faint with falsehood, while from before My word he was not dismayed; and to strengthen the hands of the wicked, so that he should not return from his evil way to keep him alive.
Therefore, you will no longer prophesy falsehood and you will no longer teach your teachings; and I will save My people from your hands, and you will know that I am Hashem.'"
The navi said: Men from the zekeinim of Yisrael came to me and sat before me.
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, these men have brought up the worship of their idols upon their hearts, and the stumbling block of their sins they have placed before their faces; shall I allow Myself to be inquired of by them through My word?

Therefore prophesy to them, and say to them, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: Every man of the house of Yisrael who brings up the worship of his idols upon his heart, and places the stumbling block of his sins before his face, and comes to the navi; I, Hashem, will respond to him with My word when he comes to seek instruction from before Me, even though he is involved in the abundance of the worship of his idols.
In order to draw the house of Yisrael near, to place teshuvah in their hearts, they who have turned away from My service and have all become defiled through the worship of their idols.'

Therefore say to the house of Yisrael, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: Return to My service, and remove from yourselves the worship of your idols; and distance all the sins of your abominable idol worship from before your faces.

For every man of the house of Yisrael, and of the converts who convert in Yisrael, who turns away from My service, and brings up the worship of his idols upon his heart, and places the stumbling block of his sins before his face, and comes to the navi to inquire of him through My word; I, Hashem, will answer him through My word.
And I will place My anger upon that man, and I will make him a sign and a proverb, and I will destroy him from the midst of My people; and you shall know that I am Hashem.
And a navi, if he errs and speaks a word, I, Hashem, have caused that navi to err; and I will raise the blow of My might against him, and I will destroy him from the midst of My people Yisrael.
And they shall bear their sins; the sin of the one who comes to learn and does not learn shall be exactly like the sin of the false prophets.

So that the house of Yisrael will no longer stray from My service, and they will no longer defile themselves with all their rebellions; and they shall be a people before Me, and I will be their God, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, if a land sins before Me by acting falsely, and I raise the blow of My might against it, and I break the staff of bread within it, and I send famine into it, and I destroy man and beast from it;
Even if these three men were in its midst—Noach, Daniel, and Iyov—they, by their merit, would save only their own souls, says Hashem Elokim.
If I cause wild beasts to pass through the land, and they bereave it, and it becomes a desolation with no one passing through because of the beasts;
Even if these three men were in its midst, as I live, says Hashem Elokim, they would save neither sons nor daughters; they alone would be saved, but the land would become a desolation.
Or if I bring those who kill with the sword upon that land, and I say, 'Let those who kill with the sword pass through the land,' and I destroy man and beast from it;
Even if these three men were in its midst, as I live, says Hashem Elokim, they would save neither sons nor daughters, but they alone would be saved.
Or if I send a plague against that land, and I pour out My wrath upon it in slaughter, to destroy man and beast from it;
Even if Noach, Daniel, and Iyov were in its midst, as I live, says Hashem Elokim, they would save neither son nor daughter; they, by their merit, would save only their own souls.
For thus said Hashem Elokim: How much more so when I send My four evil punishments—the sword, and the famine, and the wild beast, and the plague—upon Yerushalayim, to destroy man and beast from it!

And behold, there shall be left in it a saved remnant who will be brought out, sons and daughters; behold, they are coming out to you, and you will see their ways and their deeds, and you will be consoled for the evil that I brought upon Yerushalayim, all that I brought upon it.
And they will console you when you see their ways and their deeds; and you will know that not for nothing have I done all that I have done in it, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, how is the wood of the vine different from every tree, the branch that is among the trees of the forest?
Will they take wood from it to make anything? Will they take a peg from it to hang any vessel on it?
Behold, it is given to the fire for destruction; the fire consumes its two ends, and its middle is charred; is it fit for any use?
Behold, when it was whole it was not fit for use; how much less when the fire has consumed it and it is charred, will it still be fit for use?
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: Just like the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to the fire for destruction, so have I given the inhabitants of Yerushalayim.

And I will place My punishment upon them; because they transgressed the words of the Torah which were given from the midst of the fire, nations that are strong as fire will consume them; and you will know that I am Hashem, when My anger rests upon them.
And I will make the land a desolation, because they acted falsely, says Hashem Elokim."
And the name of the Congregation of Yisrael went forth among the nations because of your beauty, for it was perfect through My glory which I placed upon you, says Hashem Elokim.
But you relied on your beauty, and you went astray because of your name, and you associated yourself to worship idols with everyone who passed by; and it was not proper for you to do so.
And you took your garments and made for yourself high places covered with dark veils, and you went astray upon them, which was not proper and not fitting.
And you took the vessels of your glory, of My gold and My silver that I gave you, and you made for yourself images of males and went astray with them.
And you took your embroidered garments and covered them, and My oil and My fragrant incense you set before them.
And My good things that I gave you—fine flour, and oil, and honey with which I fed you—you set them before them as offerings to be worshipped. Was it not all these things? says Hashem Elokim.

How you multiplied anger before Me, Congregation of Yisrael! For you took your sons and your daughters, who were destined to bring forth holy descendants before Me, and you slaughtered them to them as offerings to be worshipped. Was your idolatry too small a thing in your eyes?
And you slaughtered the children, and gave them up by passing them over to them.
And in all the sins of your abominations and your idols, you did not remember the days of old, when you were wandering and forsaken, suffering in your servitude.
What will be your end for all your evil? the navi said. Woe to you that you have sinned! Woe to you that you have not repented! says Hashem Elokim.
And you built for yourself altars, and made for yourself high places in every street.

At the head of every intersection you built your high places, and you profaned your holiness, and you associated yourself to worship your idols with everyone who passed by, and you multiplied your idols.
And you went astray after the Egyptians, your neighbors, clothed in flesh, and you multiplied your idols to provoke anger before Me.

And behold, I have raised the blow of My might against you, and I have withheld your good things, and I have delivered you into the hand of your enemies, the towns of the Philistines. If I had sent My neviim to them, they would have been humbled; but you did not turn from your way of sinful counsel.
And you went astray after the children of Ashur because you did not know the Torah, and you went astray with them, and even then you did not know teshuvah.
And you multiplied your idols by associating with the people of Kenaan to walk in the customs of the Kasdim, and even in this you did not know the Torah.
How strong was the wickedness of your heart, says Hashem Elokim, in your doing all these things! With the deeds of a woman who is a harlot, she governs herself.
In your building your altar at the head of every intersection, and your high place you made in every street; and you were not like a harlot who receives payment.
The Congregation of Yisrael is like a woman beloved by her husband who plays the harlot against him, leaves her husband, and goes astray after strangers.
To every harlot they give payment, but you gave your payment to all your lovers, and you bribed them to come to you from all around with your idols.

And there was in you a change from the custom of the Congregation of Yisrael among the nations with your idols; and after you there was none who went astray like you, and in your giving payment and no payment was given to you, you were different.
Therefore, because her deeds are like a harlot, Congregation of Yisrael, accept the word of Hashem.

Thus said Hashem Elokim: Because your shame was uncovered and your disgrace was seen in your going astray after your lovers, and all the sins of your abominable idol worship, and for the guilt of the blood of your children which you slaughtered to them;

Therefore, behold, I am gathering all your lovers whom you desired to go astray after, and all whom you loved with all whom you hated; and I will gather them against you from all around, and I will uncover your shame to them, and they will see all your disgrace.
And I will judge you with the judgments of adulteresses and those who shed blood; and I will deliver you to slaughter in anger and in wrath.

And I will deliver you into their hands, and they will tear down your walls and destroy your high places, and they will strip you of your glorious garments and take the vessels of your glory, and they will leave you wandering and forsaken.
And they will bring up camps against you, and they will stone you with slingstones, and they will pierce you with their swords.

And they will burn your houses with fire, and they will execute judgments of punishment upon you in the eyes of many provinces; and I will cause you to cease from being like a harlot, and also payment you will no longer give.
And I will rest My wrath upon you, and My jealousy will depart from you; and I will make an end, and My anger will be no more.

Because you did not remember the days of old, and you provoked anger before Me with all these things, and I too have placed the punishment of your ways upon your head, says Hashem Elokim. Did you not take counsel to turn from all your abominations?
Behold, everyone who uses proverbs will use a proverb against you, saying, 'Like the deeds of the mother, so the daughter.'

Why were you a daughter to the land of Kenaan to do the deeds of a people whose fathers were raised with their children? And a sister to Sedom and Amorah, whose fathers were destroyed with their children? Was not your mother Sarah among the Hittites, and she did not do their deeds? And your father Avraham among the Emorites, and he did not walk in their counsel?
And your older sister is Shomron and her towns that dwell to your left; and your sister who is younger than you, who dwells to your right, is Sedom and her towns.
And if you had walked in their ways and done according to their abominations, your sin would have been limited; but you multiplied corruption more than they in all your ways.
As I live, says Hashem Elokim, if Sedom your sister and her towns have done as you and your towns have done!
Behold, this was the sin of Sedom your sister: pride, fullness of bread, and careless ease was hers and her towns', and the hand of the poor and needy she did not strengthen.
And they became haughty and committed abomination before Me, and I exiled them as was revealed before Me.
And Shomron did not sin half of your sins; and you multiplied your abominations more than they, and you justified your sisters with all your abominations that you committed.

You too, bear your submissiveness, for you have sought for your sisters in your sins in which you acted more abominably than they, and they are more righteous than you; and you too be ashamed and bear your submissiveness, because you justified your sisters.
And I will return their people to them, the people of Sedom and her towns, and the people of Shomron and her towns, and I will return the exiles of your people among them.
So that you may bear your submissiveness and be humbled for all that you have done in comforting them.
And your sisters, Sedom and her towns, will return to their former state, and Shomron and her towns will return to their former state; and you and your towns will return to your former state.
And Sedom your sister was not a lesson in your mouth in the day of your haughtiness,
Before your evil was revealed, like the time when the towns of Aram and all around her, the towns of the Philistines, reproached you and despised you from all around.
The sins of your sinful counsel and the worship of your abominations, you have borne them, says Hashem.
For thus said Hashem Elokim: And I will judge you as you have done, for you have despised the oath to break the covenant.
But I will remember My covenant with you in the days of old, and I will establish an everlasting covenant for you.

And you will remember your ways and be humbled when you draw near the provinces that are greater than you with those that are smaller than you, and I will give them to you for obedience, but you did not fulfill the Torah.
And I will establish My covenant with you, and you will know that I am Hashem.

So that you will remember and be ashamed, and you will no longer have cause to be haughty in the words of your mouth because of your submissiveness, when I forgive you for all that you have done, says Hashem Elokim."
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Ben adam, pose a riddle and speak a parable concerning the house of Yisrael.
And you shall say, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: A great eagle with great wings, with long pinions, covered with colored feathers, came to Levanon, and took the branch of a tall cedar.
He took the top of its shoots, and brought it to a land lacking in Divine service, to the land of Kenaan, and before the house of Yisrael came to it, he set it in a city of merchants.
And he took of the seed of the land, and planted it in a good field to sow; he planted it by much water, he set it as a planted vine.
And it sprouted, and became a strong vine of low stature, turning its branches toward him, and its roots were under him; so it became a vine, and produced branches, and sent out shoots.

And there was another great eagle with great wings and covered with feathers; and behold, this vine bent its roots toward him, and sent out its branches toward him, to water it from the furrows of its planting.
In a good field by much water it was planted, to produce branches, and to bear fruit, to become a strong vine.'

Say, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: Will it prosper? Will he not sever its roots and cut off its fruit, and all the leaves of its sprouting will wither? They will fall off, and not with mighty armies or with many people will they come to uproot it from its roots.
And behold, it is planted, will it prosper? When the east wind touches it, will it not completely wither? It will wither upon the furrows of its planting.'"
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"Say now to the rebellious people, 'Do you not know what these things mean?' Say, 'Behold, the king of Bavel came to Yerushalayim, and took her king and her princes, and brought them to him to Bavel.
And he took of the royal seed, and made a covenant with him, and bound him with an oath; and he took the mighty of the land;
So that it might be a lowly kingdom, that it might not exalt itself, but keep his covenant to serve him.

But he rebelled against him, sending his messengers to Mitzrayim, that they might give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will he who does these things escape? Can he break a covenant and escape?
As I live, says Hashem Elokim, surely in the place of the king who made him king, whose oath he despised, and whose covenant he broke, with him in the midst of Bavel he shall die.
And neither with a mighty army nor with many people will Pharaoh make war with him, in casting up a mound and in building a siege wall, to destroy many provinces.
And he despised the oath to break the covenant; and behold, he gave his hand to Pharaoh, and he has done all these things; he shall not escape.
Therefore, thus said Hashem Elokim: As I live, surely My oath which he despised, and My covenant which he broke, I will place the punishment of his ways upon his head.
And I will spread My net over him, and he will be caught in My snare, and I will exile him to Bavel, and I will judge him there for his falseness with which he acted falsely before Me.
And all his mighty men in all his armies shall fall by the sword, and those who remain shall be scattered to every wind; and you shall know that I, Hashem, have decreed by My word.

Thus said Hashem Elokim: And I will bring near from the kingdom of the house of David, which is compared to a tall cedar, and I will establish a tender one from the sons of his sons, and I will raise him up, and I will establish him by My word on a high and exalted mountain.

On the holy mountain of Yisrael I will establish him, and he will gather armies and make supports, and he will become a mighty king; and all the righteous will rely on him, and all the humble will dwell in the shade of his kingdom.

And all the kings of the nations will know that I, Hashem, have brought low the kingdom that was high, and I have exalted the kingdom that was low; I have brought low the kingdom of the nations that was strong like a green tree, and I have strengthened the kingdom of the house of Yisrael that was weak like a dry tree; I, Hashem, have decreed by My word and I will fulfill it.'"
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:
"What is this that you are using this proverb concerning the land of Yisrael, saying, 'The fathers ate sour grapes, and the teeth of the sons are set on edge'?
As I live, says Hashem Elokim, you will no longer have this proverb used in Yisrael.
Behold, all souls are Mine; as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son—they are Mine. The person who sins, he shall die.
But if a man is righteous, and does what is just and right:
He has not worshipped idols upon the mountains, nor lifted up his eyes to the idol worship of the house of Yisrael; he has not defiled his neighbor's wife, nor approached a defiled woman;
He has not oppressed any man, but has returned the debtor's pledge; he has not committed robbery, but has given his bread to the hungry, and covered the naked with a garment;
He has not given out on usury, nor taken increase; he has turned his hand from falsehood, and executed true justice between man and man;
He has walked in My statutes, and kept My judgments to do truly—he is righteous, he shall surely live, says Hashem Elokim.
And if he fathers a son who is a violent shedder of blood, and who does any of these things to a brother,
While he himself did not do any of these things, but rather ate upon the mountains, and defiled his neighbor's wife;
He oppressed the poor and needy, committed robbery, did not return the pledge, lifted up his eyes to idol worship, and committed abomination;
He gave out on usury, and took increase—shall he live? He shall not live! He has done all these abominations; he shall surely die; his bloodguiltiness shall be upon him.
And behold, if he fathers a son who sees all the sins of his father which he did, and sees them, but does not do according to them:
He has not eaten upon the mountains, nor lifted up his eyes to the idol worship of the house of Yisrael, nor defiled his neighbor's wife;
He has not oppressed any man, has not withheld the pledge, has not committed robbery, gave his bread to the hungry, and covered the naked with a garment;
He has turned his hand from the poor, has not taken usury or increase, has executed My judgments, and walked in My statutes—he shall not die for the iniquity of his father; he shall surely live.
As for his father, because he cruelly oppressed, robbed his brother by robbery, and did what was not good among his people—behold, he died in his iniquity.
Yet you say, 'Why? Does not the son bear the iniquity of the father?' But the son has done what is just and right, has kept all My statutes and done them; he shall surely live.

The person who sins, he shall die. The son shall not bear the iniquity of the father, and the father shall not bear the iniquity of the son; the righteousness of the righteous upon him shall be, and the wickedness of the wicked upon him shall be.
But if the wicked turns from all his sins that he has committed, and keeps all My statutes, and does what is just and right, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
None of his transgressions that he committed shall be remembered against him; by his righteousness that he has done, he shall live.
Do I take any pleasure at all in the death of the wicked? says Hashem Elokim. Is it not rather that he should turn from his ways and live?

But when a righteous man turns away from his righteousness and commits iniquity, doing according to all the abominations that the wicked man does—shall he live? All his righteousness that he has done shall not be remembered; in his trespass that he trespassed and in his sin that he sinned, in them he shall die.
Yet you say, 'The way of Hashem is not fair.' Hear now, O house of Yisrael: Is it not My way that is fair? Are not your ways unfair?
When a righteous man turns away from his righteousness, and commits iniquity, and dies for it—because of his iniquity that he committed, he dies.
And when a wicked man turns away from his wickedness that he committed, and does what is just and right, he shall save his soul alive.
Because he saw and turned away from all his transgressions that he committed, he shall surely live; he shall not die.
Yet the house of Yisrael says, 'The way of Hashem is not fair.' O house of Yisrael, are My ways not fair? Are not your ways unfair?

Therefore, I will judge every man according to his ways, O house of Yisrael, says Hashem Elokim. Return to My service, and remove from yourselves your idol worship, so that it will not be a stumbling block of iniquity for you.
Cast away from yourselves all your transgressions by which you have sinned, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit; and why should you die, O house of Yisrael?
For I have no pleasure in the death of one who dies, says Hashem Elokim. Return to My service, and live!"
And you, lift up a lamentation for the princes of Yisrael.
And say: What was the Congregation of Yisrael? She was like a lioness among the kings; among the rulers she raised her cubs.
And she brought up one of her cubs—he became a king, and he learned to commit slaughter; he devoured men.
And the nations heard about him; in their pit he was caught, and they brought him with chains to the land of Mitzrayim.
When she saw that her hope was cut off and lost, she took another of her cubs and set him as a king.
And he walked among the kings; he became a king, and learned to commit slaughter; he devoured men.
And he laid waste their palaces, and destroyed their cities; and the land and its fullness were made desolate by the sound of his roaring.
Then the nations gathered against him from all around, from the provinces, and they spread their net over him; in their pit he was caught.
And they put him in collars with chains, and brought him to the king of Bavel; they brought him into strongholds, so that his voice should no longer be heard upon the mountains of Yisrael.
The Congregation of Yisrael, when performing the Torah, is like a vine planted by a spring of water, whose branches are beautiful and whose boughs cast shade, planted by much water.
And there were in her strong rulers and mighty kings to subdue kingdoms, and she was exalted in her strength above her kingdom, and she was victorious with her supports through her great warriors.

But she was uprooted in fury from the land, the house of the Shechinah was exiled to another land, and a king who is strong as the east wind killed her people; they were cast out and exiled, the rulers of strength, and nations that are strong as fire consumed them.
And now she is like a vine planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty land.

And nations that are strong as fire came because of her willful sins, and killed her people; and there were no longer in her strong rulers or mighty kings to subdue kingdoms. The navi said: A lamentation is this prophecy, and it shall remain a lamentation.

And it came to pass in the seventh year, in the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month, the navi said, men from the zekeinim of Yisrael came to seek instruction from before Hashem, and sat before me.
And the word of nevuah from before Hashem was with me, saying:

"Ben adam, prophesy to the zekeinim of Yisrael and say to them, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: Are you coming to seek instruction from before Me? As I live, I will not be inquired of by you through My word, says Hashem Elokim.'
Will you rebuke them? Will you rebuke them, ben adam? Make known to them the abominations of their fathers.

And you shall say to them, 'Thus said Hashem Elokim: On the day when I chose Yisrael, and raised My hand in an oath by My word to the seed of the house of Yaakov, and revealed Myself to redeem them in the land of Mitzrayim, and raised My hand in an oath by My word to them, saying, "I am Hashem your God";
On that day I raised My hand in an oath by My word to them, to bring them out from the land of Mitzrayim into a land that I provided for them, flowing with milk and honey, a praise to all provinces.
And I said to them, "Let every man cast away the abominations before his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the idol worship of the Egyptians; I am Hashem your God."

But they rebelled against My word and were not willing to listen to My neviim; every man did not cast away the abominations of his eyes, and they did not forsake the idol worship of the Egyptians. Then I said I would pour out My wrath upon them, to fulfill My anger against them in the midst of the land of Mitzrayim.

But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations among whom they were, before whose eyes I revealed Myself to redeem them, to bring them out from the land of Mitzrayim.
And I brought them out from the land of Mitzrayim, and brought them into the wilderness.
And I gave them My statutes and made known to them My judgments, which if a man perform, he shall live through them in eternal life.
And I also gave them My Shabbos days, to be a sign between My word and them, to know that I am Hashem who sanctifies them.

But the house of Yisrael rebelled against My word in the wilderness; they did not walk in My statutes, and they spurned My judgments, which if a man perform, he shall live through them in eternal life; and My Shabbos days they profaned greatly. Then I said I would pour out My wrath upon them in the wilderness, to consume them.
But I acted for the sake of My name, so that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I brought them out.
Yet I raised My hand in an oath by My word to them in the wilderness, not to bring them into the land which I provided, flowing with milk and honey, a praise to all provinces;
Because they spurned My judgments and did not walk in My statutes, and profaned My Shabbos days; for their heart strayed after the worship of their idols.
Nevertheless, My word spared them from destroying them, and I did not make an end of them in the wilderness.
And I said to their children in the wilderness, "Do not walk in the decrees of your fathers, nor keep their laws, nor defile yourselves with the worship of their idols.
I am Hashem your God; walk in My statutes, keep My judgments, and perform them.
And sanctify My Shabbos days, and they shall be a sign between My word and you, to know that I am Hashem your God."

But the children rebelled against My word; they did not walk in My statutes, and did not keep My judgments to perform them, which if a man perform, he shall live through them in eternal life; they profaned My Shabbos days. Then I said I would pour out My wrath upon them, to fulfill My anger against them in the wilderness.
But I withdrew the blow of My might and acted for the sake of My name, so that it should not be profaned in the eyes of the nations, before whose eyes I brought them out.
I also raised My hand in an oath by My word to them in the wilderness, to exile them among the nations and scatter them among the provinces;
Because they did not perform My judgments, spurned My statutes, profaned My Shabbos days, and their eyes were after the idols of their fathers.

And I also, when they rebelled against My word and were unwilling to accept My neviim, distanced them and delivered them into the hand of their enemies; and after their foolish inclination they went, performing decrees that were not good and laws through which you shall not endure.
And I made them unclean through their gifts, in passing over every firstborn child, in order to desolate them, so that they might know that I am Hashem.
Therefore, prophesy to the house of Yisrael, ben adam, and say to them, "Thus said Hashem Elokim: In this too your fathers provoked Me to anger, in acting falsely against My word.

For when I brought them into the land which I raised My hand in an oath by My word to give to them, they saw every high hill and every thick-branched tree, and there they slaughtered their anger-provoking offerings, placed their worship sacrifices, and poured out their libations.
And I said to them: What is the high place to which you go to act foolishly there? And its name is called 'High Place' unto this day."
Therefore say to the house of Yisrael, "Thus said Hashem Elokim: Do you defile yourselves in the way of your fathers, and go astray after their abominations?

And in bringing your gifts, in passing your children through the fire, you defile yourselves with all the worship of your idols unto this day; and shall I be inquired of by you through My word, O house of Yisrael? As I live, says Hashem Elokim, I will not be inquired of by you through My word!
And that which arises in your mind and enters your heart is revealed before Me, that you say, 'We will be like the nations, like the families of the lands, to serve wood and stone.'
As I live, says Hashem Elokim, surely with a strong hand, with an outstretched arm, and with poured-out wrath will I reign over you.
And I will bring you out from among the nations, and gather you from the provinces where you were scattered, with a strong hand, with an outstretched arm, and with poured-out wrath.
And I will bring you into the wilderness of the nations, and I will execute judgment upon you there face to face.
Just as I executed judgment upon your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Mitzrayim, so will I execute judgment upon you, says Hashem Elokim.
And I will cause My decree of judgment to rest upon you, and I will bring you into the bond of the covenant.

And I will separate from you those who rebel and those who act falsely against My word; I will bring them out from the land of their dwelling, but into the land of Yisrael they shall not enter; and you shall know that I am Hashem.

As for you, O house of Yisrael, thus said Hashem Elokim: Let every man go serve his idols! But afterward, when you have returned, you will no longer desire to turn away from My word, and My holy name you shall no longer profane with your gifts and your idols.

For on My holy mountain, on the holy mountain of Yisrael, says Hashem Elokim, there all the house of Yisrael, all of them, shall serve Me in the land of the living; there I will accept their offerings willingly, and there I will seek your set-aside offerings and the best of your gifts with all your holy things.

As an offering of acceptance your offering shall be accepted willingly when I bring you out from among the nations and gather you from the provinces where you were scattered; and I will be sanctified through you in the eyes of the nations.
And you shall know that I am Hashem when I bring you into the land of Yisrael, which I raised My hand in an oath by My word to give to your fathers.
And there you shall remember your ways and all your deeds by which you were defiled, and you shall feel disgust in yourselves, seeing all your evil that you have done.
And you shall know that I am Hashem when I deal with you for the sake of My name, not according to your evil ways nor according to your corrupt deeds, O house of Yisrael, says Hashem Elokim."
